reports.title: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Highlights Recent Period Progress

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Full-year 2026 financial guidance is reiterated and consists of the following:

Item | FY 2026 Guidance
Total TTR net product revenues (AMVUTTRA, ONPATTRO)1 | $4,200 million - $4,500 million
Total Rare net product revenues (GIVLAARI, OXLUMO)1 | $500 million - $600 million
Total net product revenues1 | $4,700 million - $5,100 million
Net product revenues growth vs. 2025 at currency exchange rates as of June 30, 20261 | 57% to 71%
Net product revenues growth vs. 2025 at constant exchange rates2 | 57% to 70%
Net revenues from collaborations and royalties | $575 million - $625 million
Non-GAAP R&D and SG&A expenses3 | $2,700 million - $2,800 million
